title_en: We Asked Vogue, GQ, and a Pro Stylist to Kill Jensen Huang’s Leather Jacket
title_zh: 我们邀请了《Vogue》、《GQ》和一位专业造型师来毁掉黄仁勋的皮夹克

paragraphs.en: Jensen Huang’s midlife-crisis makeover hasn’t helped the Nvidia CEO’s image this week. In a matter of days, Huang’s questionable sartorial leanings have shifted wildly from wannabe cool Harley dad to low-down leather Lothario . Fashion moves fast, but even in the style world, this is a breakneck volte-face .
paragraphs.zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）的中年危机式形象改造，本周并没能给他的公众形象加分。短短几天里，黄仁勋那颇值得商榷的穿衣偏好来了个急转弯，从一心想扮酷的哈雷摩托老爸，一路滑向低俗的皮衣浪子。时尚风向变得快，但即便在时尚圈，这样的急转弯也快得令人咋舌。

paragraphs.en: As Emma Childs wonderfully observed in The Cut, “a $9,000 leather moto is not the outerwear of a man faithfully going home to his wife and kids after a long day of architecting the AI revolution.” And since Huang’s tomfoolery has managed to spank more than $1 trillion in less than a month, something has to be done.
paragraphs.zh: 正如艾玛·柴尔兹（Emma Childs）在The Cut上的精彩点评：“一件9000美元的机车皮夹克，可不是一个在辛苦设计完AI革命后、老老实实回家陪老婆孩子的男人该穿的外套。”而黄仁勋这番荒唐操作，不到一个月就蒸发了超过1万亿美元市值，总得有人管管了。

paragraphs.en: This is where WIRED comes to the rescue, aided by Vogue, GQ and a celebrity stylist, no less. We’ve charted the menacing glow-up of tech bros before, but merely observing the worrying trend back in 2025 is clearly no longer enough. It’s time to roll up our Armani sleeves and help.
paragraphs.zh: 于是《连线》（WIRED）出手相救，还拉上了《Vogue》、《GQ》和一位明星造型师助阵。我们此前就记录过科技男（tech bros）那令人不安的形象蜕变，但仅仅在2025年观察这一令人担忧的趋势，显然已经不够了。是时候卷起我们的阿玛尼袖子，帮上一把了。

paragraphs.en: “Tech bros were total nerds before," says Karen Clarkson , a professional stylist whose clients have included Nike, Google, Apple, Calvin Klein, and Vivienne Westwood. "Fashion didn’t touch their lives at all. They didn’t have style.” Pictures of Huang’s pre-biker fashion-vacuum days certainly bear this out. “Then, like [Jeff] Bezos, they all stepped up . And there’s a rivalry that’s come with that, whether it’s the fashion makeover, the grooming, the skin treatments, or gym regimen. Now we have Mark Zuckerberg in the front row at Prada .”
paragraphs.zh: “科技男以前都是十足的书呆子，”职业造型师凯伦·克拉克森（Karen Clarkson）说，她的客户包括耐克、谷歌、苹果、Calvin Klein和Vivienne Westwood。“时尚跟他们的生活完全不沾边。他们根本没有风格。”黄仁勋在成为机车风之前那段时尚真空期的照片，确实印证了这一点。“后来，他们像（杰夫）贝索斯（Jeff Bezos）一样，全都开始讲究起来。随之而来的还有一场攀比，无论是时尚改造、仪容打理、皮肤护理，还是健身计划。如今马克·扎克伯格（Mark Zuckerberg）都坐到普拉达（Prada）秀场的前排了。”

paragraphs.en: As a man clearly in dress distress, where better to start than with Murray Clark, head of editorial at British GQ . Controversially, Clark has a radical notion that Huang should keep clothing matters as they are. “I’d argue that Jensen Huang stays exactly how he is because this is who he is—a coiffed, leather-jacket wearing, mistake-making middle-aged man for all the world to see.”
paragraphs.zh: 既然这位男士显然深陷穿衣困境，那还有谁比英国版《GQ》编辑总监默里·克拉克（Murray Clark）更适合来支招呢？颇具争议的是，克拉克有个激进的观点：黄仁勋就该保持现状。“我倒觉得黄仁勋就该原样不变，因为这就是他本人——一个头发梳得一丝不苟、穿着皮夹克、不断犯错的中年男人，坦坦荡荡地展现在全世界面前。”

paragraphs.en: Before publicly admitting on Sunday to having an affair with a businesswoman who US intelligence says is also a Chinese spy, in 2024, Huang confessed onstage that his wife, Lori, suggested and chose his biker outfits for him because he found most other fabrics “itchy.”
paragraphs.zh: 在周日公开承认与一名被美国情报机构指认为中国间谍的女商人有染之前，黄仁勋曾在2024年当众坦言，他的机车造型是妻子洛里（Lori）提议并为他挑选的，因为他觉得大多数其他面料都“扎人”。

paragraphs.en: If Jensen keeps his jackets (he apparently owns 30 to 40), Clarkson thinks that Huang might even find himself on the catwalk. “If he wants to go down that route, then for sure Demna [Gucci’s creative director] would have him walking in his next show in Milan,” she says. “But he’s very Arnold Schwarzenegger and the Terminator with his black leathers, which is a bit close to the bone, really, with AI and that humanity is potentially doomed . I don’t know if he’s wise to lean into Arnie too heavily.”
paragraphs.zh: 如果黄仁勋保留他的皮夹克（据说他有30到40件），克拉克森认为他甚至可能走上T台。“如果他想走这条路，那德姆纳（Demna，古驰创意总监）肯定会让他在下一场米兰大秀上走秀，”她说。“但他那身黑色皮衣太像阿诺德·施瓦辛格（Arnold Schwarzenegger）和终结者了，说实话，结合AI和人类可能注定灭亡的话题，这有点太贴切了。我不确定他这么用力往阿诺身上靠是否明智。”

paragraphs.en: Let’s get some sage advice, then, from Chioma Nnadi, head of editorial at British Vogue . “If I were styling Jensen Huang, I’d advise him to cleanse the palate entirely, ditch the rock and roll shrunken leather jackets for something more somber,” Nnadi says. “A collared Oxford shirt and a navy or gray crewneck jumper would do the trick and wouldn’t read as aggressively corporate as a traditional suit. The message needs to be ‘I’m a serious person, and I’m leaving that tragic try-hard boomer dad wardrobe behind along with my despicable behavior.’”
paragraphs.zh: 那么，来听听英国版《Vogue》编辑总监奇奥马·恩纳迪（Chioma Nnadi）的睿智建议吧。“如果让我给黄仁勋做造型，我会建议他彻底清空重来，扔掉那些摇滚风的紧身皮夹克，换成更沉稳的东西，”恩纳迪说。“一件带领的牛津衬衫，配一件海军蓝或灰色的圆领针织衫就够了，也不会像传统西装那样显得咄咄逼人的企业范儿。要传递的信息应该是：‘我是个严肃的人，我要把那些可悲的、用力过猛的婴儿潮老爸行头，连同我那令人不齿的行为一起抛在身后。’”
